description: aiogram is a modern and fully asynchronous framework for Telegram Bot API written in Python using asyncio

latest_release.name: Telegram Bot API 10.4
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix link formatting by @Xeforo in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1624
* CI: harden and modernise the GitHub Actions workflows (zizmor audit, Node 24, lint/build/docs jobs) by @Olegt0rr in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1908
* Add Claude Code GitHub Workflow by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1940
* Fix exponential validation of nested RichText (#1925) by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1934
* Add dependency resolution options to project dependency installation by @Olegt0rr in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1773
* Bump dependencies and GitHub Actions (batched Dependabot updates) by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1945
* Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.1.0 to 10.2.0 in the github-actions group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1946
* docs: add missing # to via-flags by @M1h4n1k in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1938
* fix: return False for non-ASCII hash in check_webapp_signature by @nvikou in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1904
* Detect async callable objects as awaitable handlers by @Sanjays2402 in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1858
* Fix UserContextMiddleware not resolving user for stopped_message_generation by @kurupdevs in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1923
* ci(claude): allow read-only git commands and fetch full history by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1947
* Bump astral-sh/setup-uv from 10.2.0 to 10.3.0 in the github-actions group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1952
* Add OSS Scanner build, threat model and security policy by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1967
* Bump pymongo from 4.18.2 to 4.18.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1969
* Bump certifi from 2026.4.22 to 2026.10.18 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1968
* ci: gate Claude workflow to members, skip bot PRs in review, label uv security PRs by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1970
* Bump the github-actions group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1971
* Fix translation context for I18n subclasses by @troyan-dy in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1961
* fix(filters): reject invalid base64 deep-link payloads in CommandStart by @Enesuygurs in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1963
* Bump aiohttp, virtualenv and setuptools in uv.lock for security fixes by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1973
* Potential fix for code scanning alert no. 1: Incomplete URL substring sanitization by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1972
* Document polling shutdown on Windows by @troyan-dy in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1960
* Bump virtualenv from 21.14.9 to 21.14.13 in uv.lock by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1975
* fix(utils): use hmac.compare_digest for Login Widget signature check by @iSlavok in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1939
* Fix InlineKeyboardBuilder.as_markup dropping options and type as_mark… by @sinnercode228 in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1954
* Avoid an unawaited update coroutine when limited polling is cancelled by @CLCK0622 in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1958
* Support Python 3.11–3.15: drop 3.10, add 3.15 by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1976
* ci(changelog): read the skip news label from the API, not the event payload by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1977
* Add tasks_shutdown_timeout to wait for running update handlers on polling shutdown by @sinnercode228 in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1956
* Escape link URLs and attribute values in text decorations by @JrooTJunior in https://github.com/aiogram/aiogram/pull/1979
* Added
